title: Finite-presentation modules over a filtered colimit of rings
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (A_i)_{i\in I} be a directed system of commutative rings with colimit A [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then the category of finitely presented A-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] is the colimit, under extension of scalars, of the categories of finitely presented A_i-modules: every finitely presented A-module is isomorphic to M_i\otimes_{A_i}A for some i and finitely presented M_i; every A-linear map between two such fixed base changes is the base change of an A_j-linear map between their base changes at some j\ge i; and two maps at a stage that become equal over A become equal after passage to a later stage.
